debenture_sector_rule: DEBENTURE SECTOR RULE (Charter v4.2 item 4A, applied uniformly to every DEBENTURE row). A debenture's sector is the sector of its ISSUING institution, taken from that issuer's EQUITY row in this master (normalised vocabulary). The issuer is decided ONLY as follows, in order: (1) NAME EVIDENCE: if the debenture's universe name explicitly names the issuing institution, the issuer is the master EQUITY row for that institution (the name must identify one institution unambiguously; a shared word alone, e.g. 'Muktinath', does not disambiguate). (2) SYMBOL-STEM CONVENTION: NEPSE debenture symbols are formed as <issuer-code>D<maturity>[suffix] (variants: '/'-year ranges, KA suffix, UR energy-bond infix, ED green-energy suffix); the issuer code is the symbol stem before the debenture marker, and the issuer is the master EQUITY row whose symbol equals that stem EXACTLY -- no fuzzy or prefix matching beyond the exact stem, and no issuer outside the master is asserted. (3) OTHERWISE UNCONFIRMED: if neither step identifies an EQUITY row in this master, OR the identified issuer's own sector is UNCONFIRMED, the debenture's sector is UNCONFIRMED with the reason recorded in-row. Two hard prohibitions: a word in the debenture name never implies a sector (an 'Energy Bond' is not Hydropower; a 'Green Energy Debenture' is not Hydropower), and a merger successor is never asserted without a permitted source -- a legacy issuer code with no EQUITY row (e.g. BOK, CBL, NBB, RBB) is UNCONFIRMED, not remapped to a guessed successor. Exception: where the debenture NAME itself names the successor-era institution (e.g. 'Sunrise Bank Debenture' post-merger, 'Nepal Investment Bank Debenture'), the successor EQUITY row named by that institution is used and the succession is noted in-row; in both such cases the sector is Commercial Bank under either the legacy or the successor issuer, so the sector value does not depend on the succession call.
promoter_sector_rule: PROMOTER SECTOR RULE. A promoter share's sector is its PARENT's sector: the sector of the parent_symbol EQUITY row in this master (normalised vocabulary). parent_symbol is carried only where the live universe itself evidences the link by paired name (promoter row name = parent issuer name + promoter suffix). Heuristic suffix-strip candidates and unlinked rows are NOT treated as resolved parents: their sector is UNCONFIRMED. parent_verified stays false on every row: no filing or official-register extract was checked for any parent link.
mutual_fund_sector_policy: MUTUAL-FUND SECTOR POLICY. A mutual-fund scheme has no issuer sector in this master model: the sponsor/fund-house sector is NOT the scheme's sector, so no sector is asserted for any MUTUAL_FUND row (sector UNCONFIRMED, reason in-row). Ranking/exclusion of schemes is governed by instrument_type (MUTUAL_FUND), never by sector. This is a deliberate model choice, not a data gap: reintroducing a 'Mutual Fund' sector value would require an explicit owner decision.
